title: Kevin Sam (digital health pharmacist & product manager) weeks after the audiobook — 'this question keeps popping into my head on the drive to and from work'
summary: A pharmacist and health informatician describes the book still working on him weeks later, and the question it left: what more can he do to anchor a workplace in data-driven healthcare and human flourishing. He notes his own work is relatively insulated from short-term market pressure and finds keeping teams on the long game hard anyway, then lists four ideas he is carrying into practice — mission guardians, incentives that reward foundational quality, publishing standards openly, and designing defaults so the right thing is the easiest path, which he calls mission gravity.
blockquote:
"What more can I try to nurture a work environment truly anchored in data-driven healthcare and human flourishing?"
Weeks after finishing the audiobook for Eric Ries's Incorruptible, this question keeps popping into my head on the drive to and from work.
